axes[2].set_xlabel('Hour of Day', fontsize=12)
axes[2].set_ylabel('Number of Transactions', fontsize=12)
axes[2].legend(title='Fraud Status', title_fontsize='10', fontsize='9')
axes[2].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45) # Rotate x-axis labels for better readability

# Adjust layout to prevent overlapping titles and labels, ensuring space for the suptitle
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0.03, 1, 0.96])

# Save the plot to a file
plt.savefig('output.png')
